annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the average performance scores on November 2024 AMC 10/12 tests, comparing large and small models. The horizontal axis contains the model categories labeled as Llama-3.3 70B Instruct, Claude 3.5, Sonnet, Qwen 2.5 14b-Instruct, GPT 4o, GPT 4o-mini, Qwen 2.5 72b-Instruct, Gemini Flash 1.5, Gemini Pro 1.5, and phi-4, with the phi-4 label emphasized in bold. The vertical axis represents the average score (temperature = 0.5) on a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 10 units. Each category contains a light blue bar labeled "Large model" or a dark blue bar labeled "Small model," representing two model types. The large models include Llama-3.3 70B Instruct shows a value of approximately 66.4, the lowest Average score in the Large models. This is followed by Claude 3.5, Sonnet with 74.8, GPT-4 with an average score of 77.9, Qwen 2.5 72b-Instruct with a score of 78.7, and finally Gemini Pro 1.5 with an average score of 89.8, the highest among large models. For small models, the least average score of Qwen 2.5 14b-Instruct is 77.4, followed by GPT 4o-mini with score 78.2, followed by Gemini Flash 1.5 with Average score of 81.6, and finally, the highest average score is achieved by Phi-4 of 91.8. The bars are presented in an ascending order of their average score. Each bar contains the average score as its label and the error on top of it. There is a legend box on top left to identify whether the corresponding model is Large or small.
